name: bridge
author: LizardMan
description: Runs op1r's synth engines, effects and sequencers (.op1p) and Hundekraft's (.knl) on Opus as they are, with their own screens and pages, and sounds saved with them play. An alpha, a download of its own beside the starter pack.
credits: Loads op1r's .op1p files by popcorp and Hundekraft's .knl files; every bridged plugin stays its author's work
